ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   C. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Dua before and after waking up.? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Dua before and after waking up. has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Dua before and after waking up. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dua before and after waking up..

4. Which response best shows understanding of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals? (1 mark)
   A. Use Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.
   D. Say Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals has no place in daily life.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Iman? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Iman has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Iman to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Iman.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Which response best shows understanding of Milad un-Nabi? (1 mark)
   A. Use Milad un-Nabi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Milad un-Nabi has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Milad un-Nabi.
   D. Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Love? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Love has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on Love to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Love.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. Use Arabic alphabet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic alphabet.
   D. Say Arabic alphabet has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic etiquettes: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Islamic etiquettes: has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes:.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on swalah.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Dua before and after waking up. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Milad un-Nabi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Arabic alphabet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
